''See also: [[Subject One Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Subject One is a powerful entity known as a [[Dreadgod]] and is considered the progenitor or original source from which all other [[Dreadgods]] were formed. Often described as the father of the [[Dreadgods]], this being is associated with [[hunger madra]] and has been linked to the origin of that specific bloodline. Though some believe the [[Dreadgods]] only gained intelligence following the death of Subject One, others maintain that he was always an intelligent being. Subject One was previously held captive within a [[labyrinth]] that served as his prison, an environment he controlled through his own will and power. During his time ruling labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth, he could use techniques to manifest individuals he had previously consumed. His physical form has been described as having a gray-white color, and his power was eventually distributed among the other [[Dreadgods]] upon his death. His [[core binding]] is a unique and irreplaceable material that can be crafted into objects, such as a horn, and possesses the ability to grant Authority{{!}}authority over others. Additionally, Subject One is associated with specific techniques, including a [[Striker technique]] known as the [[Slumbering Wraith]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Subject One was a six-armed humanoid man with a gaping hole in his chest where a heart would normally be. Currently, the entity is represented by a mummified left hand made of chalk-white flesh. This hand acts as the pulsing heart of labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Known as the [[Slumbering Wraith]], this figure was once a man who became warped by a [[hunger aura]]. Though the entity has died, its remaining will and thoughts have interacted with others. Subject One also violated an oath during its existence.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Subject One utilizes [[hunger madra]] and possesses a borrowed Authority{{!}}authority capable of pulling others toward doors. The entity can also eat a call for help. Additionally, Subject One has used techniques that have both weakened and intensified over time.}}
